name: My Brothers Keeper
overview: The phrase 'My Brother's Keeper' originates from Cain's defiant response to God after he killed his brother Abel, refusing responsibility for his brother's welfare. This narrative in Genesis highlights the serious moral accountability we have toward one another as individuals created by God. The call to care for others is echoed in Christ's teaching to feed the hungry and welcome strangers, demonstrating that love and service are central to our duty as believers. Ultimately, God's love through the gift of His Son invites us to live out this responsibility in grace and truth.
